posts.trend: She retired. He had a health scare: Why Indians are choosing HYROX, a brutal fitness race
posts.context: At thirty, fitness transitions from a vain hobby to a violent form of stress-management.
posts.angle: We are paying to simulate manual labor because we have sitting-down anxiety.
slides: Your fitness goals have retired. You are now training for a rescue mission.

posts.caption: Your knees know exactly who you are sending this to.
